title: Mobile payment panel layout fix
summary: Contain PayPal stacking and improve mobile checkout reassurance readability.

changes.detail: Isolated the PayPal panel in a z-index 0 stacking context to contain SDK layering under the fixed header. Replaced misspelled cash-payment default heading with payment-neutral text; custom admin heading remains supported.
Mobile reassurance becomes three padded horizontal rows with 12px text and 20px line height; desktop retains three columns. Added rounded panel, larger heading and non-shrinking decorative icons.

validation.name: Pending validation
validation.detail: Lint and history checks pending. Live PayPal browser rendering and payment processing have not been tested. No deployment.
